question: What is the all-pervading power principle and what expanse belongs to it?
premises: In the middle there is an all-pervading power.
In that power abides the all-pervading Lord, bearer of the all-pervading.
This is the power principle whose manifest expanse extends down to earth.
inference: The middle locus is identified as the śakti-tattva, ruled by the all-pervading Lord and encompassing the whole manifest expanse down to earth.
uncertainties: The exact boundary implied by dharāntakaḥ may be read as ending at earth or extending as far as earth.
plain_english: In the middle is the all-pervading power. In her dwells the all-pervading Lord, who bears that all-pervading power. This is the principle of power, and the whole manifest expanse down to earth belongs to it.
